resources.string: Lets the keyboard read the conversation or form on screen so its suggestions fit what you\'re looking at. Read-only. Nothing leaves your phone.

When enabled, Agent Keyboard reads the text of the app you are typing in (for example, the last messages of a chat or the labels of a form) only while the keyboard is open, so replies and form-fill suggestions match the context. It never reads password fields, secure screens, or apps on your blocklist, and it does not tap, scroll or type anything on your behalf in this version. Everything stays on your device.
Shown while the assistant is drafting or sending a reply for you.
